title: 第7章 水榭考校，预测吉凶
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第7章水榭考校，预测吉凶
榭者，藉也。
藉景而成者也，或水边，或花畔，制亦随态。
琉光水榭是陆家老太君平日里会客的所在，坐落于陆府观池园中，水榭旁有一条崎岖流淌于观池园的琉光池水，因此而得名。
水榭临池而筑，三面临水，正好可以看到琉光池美景，小楼青砖绿瓦，屋顶为歇山回顶式，四脚翘起，颇有几分苏州府园林小筑的古雅书卷之气。
陆景前世也游览过许多园林，这三个月以来，每一旬他也总要来这里给老太君和大夫人请安，按照道理，也应该看惯了这琉光水榭才是。
可当他再次看到流光水榭中的美景，仍然感慨于陆府的奢靡。
白玉为堂金做马的陆府，靠着祖辈阴萌，就算是在这十里长宁街，也是一等一的豪奢所在。
陆景走入水榭正厅，却发现尽管自己已经按照老太君的吩咐，足足晚了一个时辰前来，厅中却还有两三位与他同辈的陆家子弟坐在檀木桌案前，专注读书。
陆家老太君治家极严，却十分喜爱读书人。
她总是期盼着陆家能出一位状元，于是陆家子弟不管喜欢读书与否，前来给老太君请安，总是会带上一本经典。
——只有陆景除外。
倒也并不是陆景清高。
只是陆景深刻的知道，因为有母亲击鼓鸣冤的事情，陆家老太君不说深恶痛绝，却也绝不可能喜欢他。
自己就算带上一百本书，老太君也只会认为是他在惺惺作态，还会落一个投机取巧，善于钻营的印象。
与其如此，还不如轻装前来，落一个轻快。
而且……读书读书，需静需稳，这么嘈杂的环境，又如何能够潜心读书？
水榭正厅中，左右两排桌案，坐在右边最前方的，是一位鬓若刀裁、眉如墨画、面如桃瓣、目若秋波的少年。
这少年头戴高冠，额箍银带，笑起来若中秋之月，一表人才。
陆家大府大少爷陆琼，也就是陆景同父异母的哥哥。

坐在左边最前方的，则是一位剑眉冷目，身躯挺拔的少年。
这少年则是陆家二府大少爷，也是之前曾向陆景索要青玥的陆烽。
陆家尚且不曾完全分家，但老太君早在许久之前，就已经令两府分治。
大府之主也是陆姓族长，已经承爵的陆神远，也就是陆景的生父，陆神远育有两子二女，陆琼是老二，陆景则是老三。
而二府之主则名为陆重山，子嗣众多，大少爷就是陆烽。
二府府主醉心于佛，终日吃斋礼佛，二府大大小小的事宜，也都是二府朱夫人在打理。
此时水榭正厅中，除了陆琼、陆烽之外，还有陆景的堂妹陆漪，也是陆烽的亲妹妹。
陆漪正和旁边一位陌生人低语。
这陌生人是是一位少女，身穿红衣，面覆轻纱，看不清面容，陆景却能看出她正好奇的望着自己。
陆景轻瞥了一眼这少女。
“莫非这就是南禾雨？”陆景心中揣测。
旋即又想起之前锦葵言语中隐隐提点，再加上此间的陌生人，就只有这个少女，也就越发认定自己的猜测。
亭中坐在上首的，自然是陆家老太君宁老夫人。
陪在一旁，正在和宁老夫人小声说话的，则是陆琼生母、陆景嫡母，也是在陆神远被贬谪之后，陆家大府实际的打理人—钟夫人。
陆景刚刚走入正厅之中，老太君依然在闭目养神。
钟夫人目光却已经落在陆景身上。
原本摇头晃脑，时不时看一眼上首老太君与钟夫人的陆琼看到陆景来了，当即有些迫不及待的放下手中典籍。
他朝陆景道：“景弟怎么这般不准时？前来给老太君与母亲请安，反倒要叫她们等你？”
一旁的陆烽闻言，也转过头来，注视着陆景。
陆景走到正厅中央，缓缓下拜：“陆景给奶奶请安，给母亲大人请安。”

钟夫人虽非陆景亲母，但在家法中，钟夫人这个嫡母，可是要比庶子的亲生母亲还要更亲的，绝不可怠慢，平日里也要以母亲大人称呼。
拜过上首的两位长辈，陆景又站起身来，向陆琼和陆烽这两位兄长见礼。
陆烽摆了摆手，继续低头看书。
陆琼眼中却多了一分兴趣，抚掌道：“景弟，你倒是胆大，来迟了也不先请罪……”
“琼儿，是我让陆景迟几刻前来的。”老太君依然没有睁眼，反倒是钟夫人轻声开口道：“这几日，我听闻陆景平日里苦读，便想着叫他迟一点来，考校一下他的学问。”
陆琼闻言，头立刻一缩，低下脑袋佯装看书，唯恐“考校学问”这种事落在他的头上。
陆景长发垂落，眼神没有丝毫变化。
他站在正厅中央，所有人的目光都集中在他身上。
包括那一位面覆轻纱的红衣少女。
红衣少女眼神闪亮，心道：“这陆景倒是沉得住气，而且，他今日给我的印象竟然比昨日读书时，更沉稳了许多……”
眼前端坐在水榭正厅中的少女，并非是陆景所揣测的那位南禾雨。
而是昨日与陆漪交谈的少女盛姿。
并非只有盛姿这般认为，钟夫人也觉得几日不见，陆景的气度突然从畏畏缩缩的庶出少年，有了许多变化。
此时此刻，陆景站在正厅中央，身躯不偏不倚，双臂也自然垂落，甚至当钟夫人的目光扫过，陆景也并不躲避，反而十分自然的迎上去。
就好像是一位……勤勉认真的读书人，不为外物所染。
“这倒是令人惊奇。”钟夫人心中诧异，面上却不动声色。
陆景并不知道，【勤勉刻苦】这个命格，不仅仅只是增益于观想、学习。
因为有此命格，他的气度，乃至于别人对他的观感、印象，都因此而发生极轻微变化。
“你苦读已久，想必对儒家典籍已颇有体悟，我今日想考校于伱，陆景，你觉得如何？”
钟夫人轻言细语，流苏长裙还因穿堂风而微微摆动，仪态颇显得尊贵。

“南国公府的小姐亲自前来，为得大概是看一看我，观其人，品其性……便如同买马一般，格马腿，观马脾性，想来这国公府的大小姐还在犹豫是否要将我‘迎娶‘入门？”
陆景想到这里，心中没来由生出一股怒气。
大伏天下，亲事历来是父母之命媒妁之言。
但到了陆景身上，南国公府国公点头提亲，陆家老太君、钟夫人都已经应允。
婚书都送了两遭，就连陆景的命契地书，早在半年前就已经被承交给了户籍司，记录在了南府外册上。
时至如今，他们其实早该完婚才是。
可是现在，南府不仅三番两次推迟婚约，这南禾雨甚至还要亲自上门看一看他才能做决定……这不免太过于讽刺了。
倒不是陆景就想去南府吃软饭，可这南府的态度……
不免让现在的陆景有些生气。
“南国公府提亲在前，但这南禾雨三番五次毁约，并不是什么诚信之人，青玥始终盼着我能够入赘南府，从此当一世富家翁……
可这富家翁，又岂是这般好当的？”
区区这几件事，就让陆景对南禾雨没有任何好感可言。
“现在我有大明王观想法，入赘并不是我唯一的出路，既然南禾雨几次三番嫌弃于我，不愿意履约，那我就遂了她的愿。”
陆景心思百转，也不去看旁边的红衣少女，只是始终沉默，似乎是惧怕被考校。
钟夫人看到陆景的反应，皱了皱眉头，暗叹道：“舫女之子，还是上不得台面。”
她轻咳一声：“陆景，我曾读过中正，自觉中正乃是为人处世之道，也知不偏不倚曰为中正，我一介妇道人家，对于儒家经典的了解也不甚多，你是否有更深的体悟？”
钟夫人自八年前那一桩旧事开始，就极为讨厌陆景，只是不愿流出“妒妇”“不容庶子”的名声，也确实没有毒打凌虐过陆景。
可是大族之中，光是区别对待就能磨去少年的心性。
钟夫人这八年来，以御下的手段令陆景母子苦不堪言。
但这关头，钟夫人也确实没有给陆景出什么难题，反而问出这么一个门槛极低，包容性却又极强的主观问题。

“大概是希望我能够回答得好一些，在南禾雨面前表现得出彩一些，如此一来，我也能够更快离开陆家，不去碍陆家众人的眼。”
陆景心中轻笑一声。
他正想装作不学无术，哑口无言，遂了南禾雨的愿，坚定她悔婚的决心。
突然间，脑海中又有一道道信息炸裂开来！
【君子为器，其锋当利。】
【钟夫人考校于你，你有如下选项：】
【凶：期期艾艾，磕磕巴巴，苦读八九年，不过笑话。
利：得“藏拙（赤）”命宫，获得一道赤色机缘。
弊：受几人厌恶，将受宁老太君家法惩罚。】
【吉：尽抒心中之意，务求在能力范围内尽善尽美，令众人哑然于你的表现。
利：获数人好感，得“参研（赤）命宫，得一道白色机缘。
弊：受到钟夫人、宁老太君厌恶。】
【大凶：拒绝回答，钟夫人责问，便怒斥她平日之恶毒。
利：得“无父无母（黄）命宫，得一道黄色机缘。
弊：大凶，极可能因此丧命。】
仅仅瞬息时间，吉凶之象就已经清晰烙印在陆景的脑海里。
陆景结舌之余，开始迅速揣测自己之后的选择。

Chapter 7 Water Pavilion School Examination, Predicting Good or Bad Things
Pavilion means borrowing.
It is made by borrowing scenery, whether it is by the water or by the flowers, and it is made according to the situation.
The Glazing Water Pavilion is where the old lady of the Lu family usually receives guests. It is located in the Guanchi Garden of the Lu Mansion. Next to the water pavilion, there is a rugged Glazing Pool water flowing in the Guanchi Garden, hence its name.
The waterside pavilion is built next to the pond, with water on three sides, so you can see the beautiful scenery of Glazed Pond. The small building has green bricks and green tiles, and the roof is in the style of resting on top of a mountain, with its legs tilted up. It has a quaint and bookish atmosphere like a small Suzhou garden building.
Lu Jing also visited many gardens in his previous life. In the past three months, he has always come here to pay his respects to the old lady and the eldest lady. Logically speaking, he should be used to seeing this glazed water pavilion.
But when he saw the beautiful scenery in Liuguang Water Pavilion again, he was still impressed by the luxury of Lu Mansion.
The Lu Mansion, where white jade works for the palace, relies on the kindness of its ancestors, and even in this ten-mile Changning Street, it is a place of first-class luxury.
Lu Jing walked into the main hall of the Waterside Pavilion, only to find that even though he had arrived an hour late as instructed by the old lady, there were still two or three Lu family members of his generation sitting in front of the sandalwood table, concentrating on reading.
The old lady of the Lu family was very strict in running the family, but she loved scholars very much.
She always hoped that the Lu family would produce a top scholar, so no matter whether the children of the Lu family liked reading or not, they would always bring a classic when they came to pay their respects to the old lady.
——Except Lu Jing.
It wasn't that Lu Jing was noble.
But Lu Jing knew deeply that because of his mother's drum beating, the old lady of the Lu family hated him deeply, but there was no way she would like him.
Even if he brought a hundred books with him, the old lady would only think that he was showing off, and would give the impression that he was opportunistic and good at playing tricks.
Instead of doing this, it is better to come lightly and arrive lightly.
And... to study, you need to be still and steady. How can you concentrate on studying in such a noisy environment?
In the main hall of the waterside pavilion, there are two rows of desks on the left and right. Sitting at the front on the right is a young man with hair like a knife cut, eyebrows like an ink painting, a face like peach petals, and eyes like autumn waves.
This young man wears a high crown on his head and a silver band on his forehead. He smiles like the Mid-Autumn Moon, showing his talent.
Lu Qiong, the eldest young master of the Lu family, is Lu Jing's half-brother.
Sitting at the front on the left is a young man with sharp eyebrows and cold eyes, and a tall and straight body.
This young man is the eldest son of the second house of the Lu family, and Lu Feng, who had asked Lu Jing for Qingyue before.
The Lu family has not yet been completely separated, but the old lady had ordered the two houses to be divided a long time ago.
The head of the mansion is also the patriarch of the clan with the surname Lu. Lu Shenyuan, who has inherited the title, is Lu Jing's biological father. Lu Shenyuan has two sons and two daughters, Lu Qiong is the second eldest and Lu Jing is the third.
The head of the second mansion was named Lu Chongshan, and he had many heirs. The eldest young master was Lu Feng.
The head of the second palace is obsessed with Buddhism and eats fasting and worships Buddha all day long. All the affairs of the second palace are also taken care of by Mrs. Zhu of the second palace.
At this time, in the main hall of the waterside pavilion, in addition to Lu Qiong and Lu Feng, there was also Lu Jing's cousin Lu Yi, who was also Lu Feng's biological sister.
Lu Yizheng was whispering to a stranger next to him.
This stranger was a girl, wearing red clothes and a gauze covering her face. Her face could not be seen clearly, but Lu Jing could see that she was looking at him curiously.
Lu Jing glanced at the girl.
"Could this be Nan Heyu?" Lu Jing speculated in his mind.
Immediately, he remembered the hint mentioned in Mallow's words before, plus the stranger here, this girl was the only one, and he became more and more convinced of his guess.
The person sitting at the top of the pavilion is naturally Mrs. Junning, the old lady of the Lu family.
Accompanying her, talking quietly to Mrs. Ning, was Lu Qiong's biological mother, Lu Jing's aunt, and the actual manager of the Lu family's mansion after Lu Shenyuan was demoted - Mrs. Zhong.
Lu Jing had just walked into the main hall, and the old lady was still closing her eyes to rest.
Mrs. Zhong's eyes had already fallen on Lu Jing.Lu Qiong, who was originally shaking his head and glancing at the old lady and Mrs. Zhong from time to time, saw Lu Jing coming and immediately put down the classics in his hands impatiently.
He said to Lu Jing: "Why is Brother Jing so unpunctual? You came to greet the old lady and mother, but you asked them to wait for you?"
Lu Feng on the side also turned his head and stared at Lu Jing when he heard this.
Lu Jing walked to the center of the main hall and bowed slowly: "Lu Jing would like to say hello to grandma, and say hello to mother."
Although Mrs. Zhong is not Lu Jing's biological mother, in family law, Mrs. Zhong, the legitimate mother, is closer than the biological mother of the concubine. She must not be neglected and must be addressed as mother on weekdays.
After paying homage to the two elders above him, Lu Jing stood up again and bowed to his two elder brothers, Lu Qiong and Lu Feng.
Lu Feng waved his hand and continued to read.
There was more interest in Lu Qiong's eyes, and she said stroking her hands: "Brother Jing, you are so brave, you didn't apologize for being late..."
"Qiong'er, I asked Lu Jingchi to come here a few moments ago." The old lady still didn't open her eyes, but Mrs. Zhong said softly: "In the past few days, I heard that Lu Jing was studying hard on weekdays, so I thought about asking him to come later and test his knowledge."
When Lu Qiong heard this, he immediately shrank his head, lowered his head and pretended to read, lest something like "testing school knowledge" would happen to him.
Lu Jing's long hair fell down, and his eyes did not change at all.
He stood in the middle of the main hall, and everyone's eyes were focused on him.
Including the girl in red with her face covered with gauze.
The girl in red's eyes sparkled, and she thought to herself: "This Lu Jing is quite calm, and the impression he gave me today is actually much calmer than when he was studying yesterday..."
The girl sitting in front of him in the main hall of the waterside pavilion was not the Nan Heyu as Lu Jing had guessed.
But it was Shengzi, the girl who talked to Lu Yi yesterday.
Sheng Zi was not the only one who thought so, Mrs. Zhong also felt that after not seeing each other for a few days, Lu Jing's demeanor suddenly changed a lot from that of a timid concubine.
At this moment, Lu Jing stood in the center of the main hall, his body leaning to neither side, his arms hanging down naturally. Even when Mrs. Zhong's eyes swept across, Lu Jing did not avoid it, but faced her very naturally.
It's like a... diligent and conscientious scholar who is not tainted by external things.
"This is surprising." Mrs. Zhong was surprised in her heart, but her face remained calm.
Lu Jing didn't know that the fate of "diligence and hard work" was not only beneficial to visualization and learning.
Because of this fate, his demeanor, and even other people's perceptions and impressions of him, will change slightly.
"You have been studying hard for a long time, and you must have a good understanding of Confucian classics. Today I want to take the exam at You, Lu Jing, what do you think?"
Mrs. Zhong spoke softly, her long fringed skirt swayed slightly due to the draft, and her demeanor looked quite noble.
"The young lady from Nanguo Duke's Mansion came here in person, probably to take a look at me, to observe me as a person, and to appreciate my character... It's like buying a horse, testing its legs and observing its temperament. I wonder if the eldest lady who came to this Duke's Mansion is still hesitant to 'marry' me?"
When Lu Jing thought of this, he felt angry for no reason.
In today's world, marriage has always been the order of the parents and the advice of the matchmaker.
But when it came to Lu Jing, the Duke of Nanguo Mansion nodded and proposed marriage, and both the Lu family's old lady and Mrs. Zhong agreed.
The marriage certificate was sent twice, and even Lu Jing's life deed and land certificate had been handed over to the Household Registration Department half a year ago and recorded in the Nanfu Foreign Register.
By now, they should have gotten married long ago.
But now, Nanfu not only postponed the engagement time and time again, but Nan Heyu even had to come to see him in person before making a decision... This was too ironic.
It's not that Lu Jing just wants to go to Nanfu to eat soft food, but Nanfu's attitude...
It can't help but make Lu Jing a little angry now.
"The Duke of Nanguo proposed marriage first, but Nan Heyu broke the contract again and again. This is not a matter of good faith.Man, Qingyue has always hoped that I could enter Zhennan Mansion and become a rich man for the rest of my life...
But how could this rich man be so easy to take? "
These few things made Lu Jing not have any favorable impression of Nan Heyu.
"Now I have the idea of the Ming Dynasty King. Marriage is not my only way out. Since Nan Heyu has disliked me several times and is unwilling to fulfill the contract, then I will fulfill her wish. "
Lu Jing's mind was racing, and he didn't look at the girl in red next to him. He just remained silent, as if he was afraid of being tested.
Seeing Lu Jing's reaction, Mrs. Zhong frowned and sighed secretly: "The son of a young lady still cannot get on the stage. "
She coughed softly: "Lu Jing, I have read Zhongzheng. I feel that Zhongzheng is the way to live in the world. I also know that impartiality is called Zhongzheng. I am a woman and do not know much about Confucian classics. Do you have a deeper understanding? "
Mrs. Zhong had hated Lu Jing very much since the old incident eight years ago. She just didn't want to be known as a "jealous woman" and "not intolerant of bastards". It was true that she had never beaten or tortured Lu Jing.
But among the big families, just treating them differently can weaken a young man's temperament.
In the past eight years, Mrs. Zhong has used her imperial methods to make Lu Jing's mother and son miserable.
But at this juncture, Mrs. Zhong did not pose any problems to Lu Jing. Instead, she asked such a subjective question with a very low threshold and an extremely inclusive yet strong one.
"I probably hope that I can answer better and perform better in front of Nan Heyu. In this way, I can leave the Lu family faster and not be an eyesore to everyone in the Lu family. "
Lu Jing chuckled in his heart.
He was just about to pretend to be uneducated and speechless, so he fulfilled Nan Heyu's wish and strengthened her determination to regret the marriage.
Suddenly, another stream of information exploded in my mind!
[A gentleman is a weapon whose edge should be sharp. 】
[Mrs. Zhong takes the exam for you, you have the following options:]
[Ominous: Ai Ai every period, stumbling, studying hard for eight or nine years, nothing more than a joke.
Profit: Get the "Zangzhuo (Red)" Life Palace, and get a red opportunity.
Disadvantage: Being disliked by several people, he will be punished by Mrs. Ning’s family law. 】
[Ji: Express what is in your heart, strive to be perfect within your capabilities, and make everyone dumbfounded by your performance.
Profit: Winning the favor of several people, you can "participate in the (Red) Life Palace, and get a white opportunity."
Disadvantages: Disliked by Mrs. Zhong and Mrs. Ning. 】
[Big Bad: Refusing to answer, Mrs. Zhong asked, and angrily scolded her for her usual viciousness.
Pros: Get the "Fatherless and Motherless (Yellow) Life Palace, and get a yellow chance."
Disadvantages: Very dangerous, very likely to result in death. 】
In just a moment, the good and bad signs were clearly imprinted in Lu Jing's mind.
Lu Jing was speechless and began to quickly speculate on his future choices.
